# Lyfe task manager

Lyfe is Sebastian (Sebo) and Alomi's task manager.

Machine-readable integration metadata:
https://ssiatkowski.github.io/lyfe/lyfe-ai.json

Public read-only task API:
https://us-west2-lyfe-cacf7.cloudfunctions.net/taskReadApi

Usage:
- For Sebastian/Sebo, use owner=Sebo.
- For Alomi, use owner=Alomi.
- Shared tasks owned by All are included automatically.
- If the user's identity is unclear, ask whether they are Sebo or Alomi before fetching.
- For general task review, prioritization, optimization, planning, or 'check my tasks', fetch the FULL active task system with &through=2099-12-31. This includes future tasks as well as overdue tasks.
- For narrowly scoped overdue/due-today questions, omit through so the endpoint defaults to today; use status to distinguish overdue from due_today.
- For a requested future horizon, set &through=YYYY-MM-DD to that inclusive date.
- For catch-up planning, prefer the full active task system so upcoming workload is considered alongside overdue items.
- A very overdue repeating task represents one outstanding recurrence, not one required completion for every missed interval.
- Do not repeatedly refetch the same task list unless the user asks for a refresh.

Examples:
- Full Sebo system: https://us-west2-lyfe-cacf7.cloudfunctions.net/taskReadApi?owner=Sebo&through=2099-12-31
- Full Alomi system: https://us-west2-lyfe-cacf7.cloudfunctions.net/taskReadApi?owner=Alomi&through=2099-12-31
- Sebo due/overdue through today: https://us-west2-lyfe-cacf7.cloudfunctions.net/taskReadApi?owner=Sebo
- Alomi due/overdue through today: https://us-west2-lyfe-cacf7.cloudfunctions.net/taskReadApi?owner=Alomi

The public reader has no write routes and exposes only task-planning fields. Add/modify use a separate private API; delete is not available through the API.
